name: Saijou Sadayoshi
source: Your former boss, and the leader of the sales department. Has a calm disposition, but is good at his job and is able to approach a situation from the other person's point of view. But beneath that calm surface lies a jealous and possessive heart; get too close, and before you know it you'll be trapped in his cage. Capable of manipulating people to get what he wants without batting an eye.
